privacySettings.title: Privacy settings
privacySettings.hideFromAlgorithmicRecommendationsLabel: Hide my posts from algorithmic recommendations (e.g. Bsky Discover feed)
privacySettings.hideFromAlgorithmicRecommendationsDescri: When enabled, your posts will only appear in the Bluesky Discover feed to people who follow you. This preference is recorded at the account level in your PDS, so other AT Protocol apps can also read it, but whether they honor it is up to each app. It may take up to an hour to fully take effect.

accountSettings.title: Account settings
accountSettings.emailChangeRequested: A confirmation email has been sent to the new address. Open the link in the email to complete the change.
accountSettings.revokeAllSessionsDescription: Invalidates every login session, including this device. Use this if you notice unfamiliar logins or lose a device. You will need to log in again afterwards.
accountSettings.revokeAllSessionsConfirm: This will sign you out of all sessions, including this device. Continue?
accountSettings.totpEnabled: Two-factor authentication with an authenticator app is enabled.
accountSettings.totpDisabled: Two-factor authentication with an authenticator app is disabled.
accountSettings.totpScanHint: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app, or enter the secret below.
accountSettings.recoveryCodesNotice: Save these recovery codes somewhere safe. Each code can be used once, and they will not be shown again after you leave this page.
accountSettings.passkeyDescription: Sign in without a password using your device screen lock, fingerprint, or face. You can register multiple passkeys.

verifyEmailChange.successBody: Your email address has been updated successfully.

appTokensSettings.empty: No app tokens have been issued.
appTokensSettings.issuedWarning: This token is shown only now. It cannot be shown again once you close this.

importExport.title: Import & Export
importExport.description: Enter one account ID per line to import your follows. You can also drag and drop a text file to load it.
